notes: Check 1: no Clarity election list for Hays (elections.json 404). The county Elections page (hayscountytx.gov/172/Elections, CivicPlus) links only an 'Election Results Archive' (Archive.aspx?AMID=53), whose entries (for example 'May 26, 2026 Primary Runoff', 'March 3, 2026 Primaries', 'November 5, 2024 General (ZIP)') hold only official files: 'Official Canvass Results', 'Official Cumulative Results', 'Official Results Reports (ZIP)', CVR export, certification and reconciliation. This server stamps every page with the request time as Last-Modified, so it gives no upload evidence. One web search listed an egovlink.com-hosted 'Cumulative Results - Democratic Party - unofficial' PDF for the 2026 primary, but that URL now returns 404, and a livevoterturnout.com/HaysTX election-night site that only covers November 2020 (Last-Modified 2022). No election-night file for the three target elections could be read. Check 3 pending (wayback-data branch not on origin).
tag_rationale: All three elections are UNDETERMINED (no Clarity log, only official files on the county site, check 3 pending), so by rule the tag is UNKNOWN.
